business_summary: GrandiT Co., Ltd. researches and develops, produces, and sells electronic wet chemicals, electronic specialty gases, and precursor materials in China and internationally. The company offers electronic grade hydrofluoric acid, electronic grade sulfuric acid, electronic grade nitric acid, electronic grade hydrochloric acid, electronic grade ammonium hydroxide and fluoride, electronic grade phosphoric acid, etch solution, post-etch and post-CMP cleaning solution, fluorine/nitrogen mixture, tetrakis titanium, and hexachlorodisilane; and high-purity chlorine, hydrogen chloride, fluoride, monofluoromethane, difluoromethane, trifluoromethane, hexafluoroethane, octafluorocyclobutane, octafluorocyclopentene, hexafluorobutadiene, tungsten hexafluoride, hydrogen, silane, carbon dioxide, and chlorine trifluoride, as well as hydrofluoroether-based fluorinated liquids, perfluoropolyether-based fluorinated liquids, and perfluoroalkene/alkane-based fluorinated liquids. It provides its products for semiconductors wafer fabrication, silicon/compound substrate manufacturing, semiconductor display manufacturing, optical fiber and preform manufacturing, and photovoltaic manufacturing. GrandiT Co., Ltd. was incorporated in 2017 and is headquartered in Quzhou, China.
business_summary_ko: 그랜디티(GrandiT Co., Ltd.)는 중국 및 해외에서 전자 습식 화학물질, 전자 특수 가스, 전구체 재료를 연구, 개발, 생산, 판매하고 있습니다. 이 회사는 전자 등급 불화수소산, 전자 등급 황산, 전자 등급 질산, 전자 등급 염산, 전자 등급 수산화암모늄 및 불화물, 전자 등급 인산, 식각 용액, 식각 후 및 CMP 후 세척 용액, 불소/질소 혼합물, 테트라키스 티타늄, 헥사클로로디실란을 제공합니다. 고순도 염소, 염화수소, 불화물, 모노플루오로메탄, 디플루오로메탄, 삼불화메탄, 헥사플루오로에탄, 옥타플루오로시클로부탄, 옥타플루오로시클로펜텐, 헥사플루오로부타디엔, 육불화텅스텐, 수소, 실란, 이산화탄소, 삼불화염소, 히드로플루오로에테르계 불소화액, 퍼플루오로폴리에테르계 불화액, 퍼플루오로알켄/알칸 기반의 불소화 액체. 반도체 웨이퍼 제조, 실리콘/복합 기판 제조, 반도체 디스플레이 제조, 광섬유 및 프리폼 제조, 광전지 제조를 위한 제품을 제공합니다. (주)그랜디티
